seed_bank.final_rule: first R entries with R<=4091, chosen from power before final training/test; no outcome-dependent replacement

training.budget_stop_policy: best selected state after at least one fully validated epoch per required phase; cooperative nominal active-time budget, not hard wall

evaluation_endpoint_amendment.prospective_primary: arithmetic mean of MSE across fixed trained seed replicates and chronological endpoints
evaluation_endpoint_amendment.RMSE_reporting: sqrt of aggregate MSE; not averaging predictions into an ensemble
evaluation_endpoint_amendment.historical_mean_seed_RMSE: preserved and additionally required favorable against every rival; not silently substituted
evaluation_endpoint_amendment.reason: standard temporal loss contrasts have an additive squared-error estimand; root of mean MSE is monotone for this new prospective endpoint

statistical_settings.causal_instruments: constant plus sqrt(known six-return A)/fit-only reference RMS

family.projections: record raw sigma7 and common max(raw,sqrt(A)) for all methods; selection uses projected loss; primary evaluation uses projected loss

fairness.information_set: same OHLCV/endpoints and legally available causal history; intrinsic candidate normalization declared
fairness.benchmarks: historical validation-selected recipe fixed; no new final-test tuning
fairness.new_panel_HPO: none; all use frozen recipe and one common per-system total opportunity budget. Report this limitation, never claim new-panel HPO optimality.

partitions.local_support: 15 closes for seven known sigma lags and next sigma7 label; purge by observed trading-bar indices
partitions.ARIMA_filter_history: causal past fitted/filter state can span earlier partitions like learned weights; does not make local purges a claim of disjoint global information

publication.before_final_training: final complete protocol plus data identities and method/power reports published and read back
publication.before_test: selected checkpoint manifest and calibrator hashes published and read back before labels are opened
publication.GitHub_checkpoint: encrypted shards preserve complete checkpoints, saved predictions and analysis; bounded public metadata/receipts plus deterministic inventory; no raw market arrays or plaintext weights

public_payload_policy.full_prediction_CSVs: always preserved in encrypted checkpoint and full export; never sampled or discarded for public ZIP size
public_payload_policy.full_export: export_case produces complete saved derived CSV/receipt archive without new model queries

input_noise.assumption: multiplicative measurement error on O/H/L/volume; close and true labels/history remain exact; all methods share each disturbed panel

missingness.assumption: independent missing O/volume entries after first known window row; causal carry-forward and OHLC clipping; close/labels remain exact

stage_activation_rule: stage_permissions records disabled defaults; explicit author activation flags are required for acquisition, planning/final training and test opening; activation never bypasses evidence checks
